text:
hana: Dropping a focused mock for the Trace Viewer header: proposing an Audit trail link next to Export and a keyboard-accessible 'Copy correlation identifier' chip. Goal: make exports discoverable but keep header minimal. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1842105678.png
omar: Nice. A couple product constraints: audit trail should record who triggered exports and what scope (full trace vs request). For compliance we need an export reason field if org is enterprise. Also prefer audit entries link to download artifacts rather than embed them in the log.
linda: UX thoughts: keep the chip compact: show first 8 chars + ellipsis, aria-expanded to reveal full id. Keyboard: when chip focused, Enter opens a small popover with full id + 'Copy' and 'Copy with span' buttons. Microcopy: button text should read "Copy correlation identifier" not "Copy ID".
aria: Accessibility checklist: ensure chip is a native button with aria-label=\"Copy correlation identifier\" and aria-expanded reflects expansion state. When copy success occurs announce via aria-live region: \"Correlation identifier copied\". For the audit trail link use aria-describedby pointing to a short description that says \"Shows export history for this trace\". Color contrast: ensure chip text meets 4.5:1 at small sizes or add background token.
hana: Privacy note: show a small lock icon for exports that include request bodies or headers. If export includes PII fields, show a warning in the export modal and require an explicit checkbox \"I confirm data scrubbed\" (checked by default for public orgs).
omar: Backend follow-up: we can add audit entries in /api/audit/exports with fields user, timestamp, scope, size_bytes, job_id. For permalink copying use short ids and optional ?span= flag. For large exports start a job and attach job_id to audit entry; downloads panel can fetch by job_id.
linda: Tiny copy detail: tooltip on hover should show truncated preview and a small \"Reveal full\" control; do not show full id on hover by default to avoid accidental exposure. Also for screen reader users ensure full id is available in the expanded popover.
audit-bot: Audit rule reminder: exports containing request headers or bodies require manager approval for enterprise orgs. See https://redwood.policy/export-audit.
aria: Implementation hint: use navigator.clipboard.writeText(value) with try/catch and fallback to a hidden textarea. Ensure exported filenames include trace id and sanitized timestamp, eg \"trace_abcd1234_2026-03-22.zip\".
hana: Decision draft: - Keep Export in kebab and add a smaller Export quick-action in secondary row. - Add Audit trail link in header that opens activity modal. - Copy chip defaults to trace_id; chevron expands to include span_id. - Exports that include bodies flagged and require consent/approval. I'll update mock and flows.
audit-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1842105678  feedback window 48h :calendar:
